title: Showing only the ones that match
idea: Use an if inside a loop to print only the values that satisfy a condition.

exercises.explanation: Even numbers 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 — only those pass i % 2 == 0.

exercises.prompt: Which numbers print for that 'below 4' loop?
The loop still visits every number; the if just decides which ones get printed.
exercises.explanation: True. Every pass happens; only matching passes reach the print.

exercises.prompt: Arrange a loop that prints only odd numbers 1..10 (i % 2 == 1).
exercises.explanation: for header, then the if for odd, then the indented print.

exercises.prompt: Which numbers print for that odd-number loop over 1..10?
If NO number matches the condition, what prints?
exercises.explanation: If nothing matches, the print never runs, so nothing is shown.

exercises.prompt: Why is 'visit all, show some' a useful pattern?
options: It filters a range to the values you want
It only works for even numbers
exercises.explanation: It lets you filter a range down to just the values you care about, without extra tools.
